era_en: Republic of China to People's Republic (1907-1984)
school: 中国人民解放军/华东野战军
historical_significance: 粟裕（1907-1984），湖南会同人，中国人民解放军大将，中国近代军事史上最具战略眼光与战术创新能力的大将之一。他历任红十军团参谋长、新四军第二支队副司令员、山东野战军副司令员、华东野战军副司令员兼参谋长等职，指挥或参与了苏中七战七捷、孟良崮战役、豫东战役、淮海战役、渡江战役等重大战役。以善打大仗、硬仗、奇仗著称，有'战神'之誉。其用兵特点为敢于集中优势兵力打歼灭战、善于在劣势条件下捕捉战机、注重战役层面的细节设计。1955年被授予大将军衔。
historical_significance_en: Su Yu (1907-1984), from Huittong, Hunan. One of the ten grand marshals of the PLA and among the most strategically visionary and tactically innovative generals in modern Chinese military history. He served as staff officer of the Red Tenth Army Corps, deputy commander of the New Fourth Army's Second Detachment, deputy commander of the Shandong Field Army, and deputy commander and chief of staff of the East China Field Army. He directed or participated in major campaigns including the Seven Victories of Central Jiangsu, the Menglianggu Campaign, the Yudong Campaign, the Huaihai Campaign, and the Yangtze Crossing Campaign. Known for fighting large-scale, hard-fought, and出奇制胜 battles, he was called 'the God of War'. His signature approach: concentration of overwhelming force for annihilative engagements, seizing opportunities in numerically inferior positions, and meticulous campaign-level design. Awarded the rank of Grand Marshal in 1955.
key_concepts: 集中优势兵力打歼灭战

cross_references.relation_type: 毛泽东军事思想与实践中的杰出执行者与丰富者
cross_references.description_zh: 粟裕是毛泽东军事思想在解放战争中的杰出实践者。他提出的'集中优势兵力，各个歼灭敌人'的原则与毛泽东的战略思想高度一致，同时在具体战役中展现出超越一般执行的创造性。如孟良崮战役中在国民党军重兵集团中'百万军中取上将首级'的胆识，以及淮海战役中建议中央军委发起战役的主动精神，都体现了对毛泽东军事思想的深化发展。
cross_references.description_en: Su Yu was an outstanding practitioner who enriched Mao Zedong's military thought during the Liberation War. His principle of 'concentrating superior forces to destroy the enemy one by one' aligned closely with Mao's strategic thought, while his specific campaign execution demonstrated creativity beyond routine application. The Menglianggu Campaign's audacity of striking at the enemy commander within a massive heavy-force cluster, and his initiative in proposing the Huaihai Campaign to the CPC Central Military Commission, all reflect deepening and developing Mao's military doctrine.

cross_references.relation_type: 与蒋介石的军事对弈：战略劣势下的战役胜利者
cross_references.description_zh: 粟裕在与蒋介石指挥系统的对弈中，多次以少胜多、以弱胜强。从苏中七战七捷到淮海战役，他面对的是国民党最精锐的部队和最强大的装备。他的成功揭示了战略资源劣势方的战役制胜之道：通过精确的战场阅读、集中的兵力投放和出其不意的进攻方向，在局部形成绝对优势。
cross_references.description_en: Su Yu repeatedly won victories against Chiang Kai-shek's command system despite overall strategic inferiority. From the Seven Victories of Central Jiangsu to the Huaihai Campaign, he faced the National Revolutionary Army's most elite units and most powerful equipment. His success revealed the path to campaign victory for the strategically inferior side: precise battlefield reading, concentrated force deployment, and unexpected attack directions to form absolute local superiority.

cross_references.relation_type: 刘伯承与粟裕的协同：华东战场的双剑合璧
cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯承与粟裕在华东战场形成了卓越的将帅配合。刘伯承以谋略见长，粟裕以战役执行见长，两人配合默契。在淮海战役中，总前委由刘伯承、陈毅、邓小平、粟裕、谭震林组成，粟裕作为参谋长实际承担了战役的具体筹划与指挥。两人互补的特点成为中国革命战争史上将帅协同的典范。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bocheng and Su Yu formed an outstanding command partnership on the East China battlefield. Liu excelled at strategic planning while Su excelled at campaign execution; their cooperation was remarkably effective. During the Huaihai Campaign, the General Front Committee consisted of Liu Bocheng, Chen Yi, Deng Xiaoping, Su Yu, and Tan Zhenlin, with Su Yu as chief of staff assuming actual responsibility for campaign planning and command. Their complementary strengths became a paradigm of general coordination in the Chinese revolutionary war.
